description: Separate molecule-wall and viscous transport contributions to nitrogen flux through a hydrotalcite-coated support. Entire temperature regimes are held out, with calibrated absolute pressures and source flux units.
independent_unit: Single S-HT membrane and nitrogen only. Whole nominal temperatures: train 25/200/500 Celsius; dev 350; test 300/400/450. Actual temperatures remain inputs. Source validation sheet and other gases/materials are outside this contract.
limitations: Single S-HT membrane, pure nitrogen; no independent membrane replication
Known transport families, not direct pore-size identification
Additive effective Knudsen and viscous contributions
A viscosity power law approximates the finite measured temperature range
title: Gas transport through a porous membrane
